newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CARACAS STOCKS END OFF, CORIMON UP.
newsitem.headline: CARACAS STOCKS END OFF, CORIMON UP.

text.p: Caracas stocks ended slightly weaker on very low volume, but Corimon bucked the trend to rise 1.26 percent higher by the close, traders said on Wednesday.
The exchange index fell 31 points (0.34 percent) to close at 9,274, while the Merinvest index slipped 0.62 percent to close at 147 points.
Over half the day's 66 million share trades was taken up by trading in Corimon stock, which rose 1.26 percent to 16.05 bolivars per share.
About half of the Corimon trading was cross-trades by Activalores and Bancaracas, brokers added.
